title: termal_read_mailbox given a session id returns a bare 404; the error should name the caller's pairwise mailbox ids with that session
outcome: A root agent that passes a session id (its own or a peer's) where a mailboxId is expected gets an actionable answer naming the right mailbox, without broad mailbox enumeration
acceptance: termal_read_mailbox (and the CLI mailbox read) called with a session-* value instead of a mailbox-* id returns an explicit error that says the argument is a session id and names the caller's pairwise mailbox id(s) with that session, or none; a mailbox-* id that does not exist still returns not found
The root coordination guidance states that the mailboxId comes from the mailbox notification or termal_send_to_session's result, and that TERMAL_SESSION_ID is an identity, not a mailbox id
Focused tests cover a session id argument with an existing pairwise mailbox, with none, and an unknown mailbox id; a review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher
